Glance 2026.07.24 improves media, Office, and text previews.

## Highlights

- View richer audio and video details, with optional extended metadata from `ffprobe`.
- Reopen recently previewed Office documents without repeating conversion.
- Configure Office preview cache size and expiration.
- Improve text preview responsiveness, scrollbar styling, and opacity consistency.
- Install Glance on supported Windows 10 systems.
